_description: Data sources of the pipeline. Read by v2_reentrenamiento/etl/_comun.py: if a raw file is missing, the ETL scripts print the link and the expected path; if its SHA-256 differs from the one recorded here, they warn that it is not the file used in the article (and stop with --estricto).

_fields.access_date: date the source was accessed or downloaded, or "not recorded"
_fields.path: path relative to the repository root (null when the file is not stored in the repository)
_fields.size_bytes: size in bytes; for text files tracked in git, size of the checked-out file with LF line endings
_fields.sha256: SHA-256; for text files tracked in git, method 2 of 01_configuracion/hashes_congelados.json (CRLF -> LF, then SHA-256); otherwise the bytes as they are. null when not recorded
